dedupe_keys.name: national disaster risk profile of bulgaria with hazard risk assessment annexes

description: The National Disaster Risk Profile of Bulgaria is published by the Directorate General Fire Safety and Civil Protection of the Bulgarian Ministry of Interior among its strategic documents. The page lists the profile itself with twelve technical annexes: input data, and risk assessments for floods, earthquakes, landslides, forest fires, droughts, extreme heat, storms, extreme winter conditions, human infectious diseases, plant and animal diseases, and technological accidents in Bulgaria, together with a disaster risk management plan. The same section of the site links disaster risk maps, guidance for regional and municipal disaster risk reduction programmes, the evaluation of the national disaster risk reduction strategy and reports from an advisory services agreement between the Ministry and the International Bank for Reconstruction and Development. The documents are free to download online; the site has terms of use and no open licence is named. Caveats: the documents are in Bulgarian, they are assessments, not raw data, and the page does not give their date. Coverage is Bulgaria. It supports multi-hazard exposure and emergency response planning for infrastructure, and the input data annex can inform national risk models; related records are the Ireland National Risk Assessment 2023 and the Mexico Atlas Nacional de Riesgos.
